purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-18901 with one node:test case each in test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-211) removes the flags as it makes them pass.
title: US-18901 UX intake gate suite (journey-declare)

testCases.description: [happy] Given an intake run carrying --ui with a value from [none | light | central], when intake writes the intakeClassification, then rcf/discovery/journey.json exists with JourneyRecord.ui equal to the declared value, JourneyRecord.declaredVia equal to "intake" and JourneyRecord.declaredAt equal to the run time.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-1 happy: an intake run carrying ui with a value from none

testCases.description: [happy] Given a tree with or without an existing journey.json, when the operator runs the journey declare verb with --ui and a value from [none | light | central], then journey.json exists with JourneyRecord.ui equal to the value and JourneyRecord.declaredVia equal to "declare", --as-built sets JourneyRecord.asBuilt true and its absence leaves the field as it was (false on a record intake or init wrote), and lowering the value (central to light, or light or central to none) without --reason is refused with exit 2 naming the flag while the same call with --reason records the reason on the record.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-2 happy: a tree with or without an existing journeyjson

testCases.description: [happy] Given an interactive intake run with no --ui flag, when intake reaches the declaration, then it prints the shared matcher's UI signals over the artefact text (an empty list when none match) and the proposed value (none when no signal matched), asks for the declaration, and the value written is the one the operator typed, never the proposal.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-3 happy: an interactive intake run with no ui flag

testCases.description: [failure] Given a non-interactive intake run through --input with no ui field, when it runs, with or without UI signals in the artefact text, then intake exits 2 naming the ui field and writes neither the intakeClassification nor journey.json, so no intake on this version completes without a declaration.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-4 failure: a noninteractive intake run through input with n

testCases.description: [edge] Given a tree with no rcf/discovery/journey.json, when readJourneyRecord reads it, then it returns null (the grandfathered state every later reader folds to notApplicable), and rcf discover intake --dry-run and rcf discover journey declare --dry-run on that tree print the record they would write and leave rcf/discovery/ absent.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-5 edge: a tree with no rcfdiscoveryjourneyjson

testCases.description: [edge] Given rcf init on this version, when the tree is created, then rcf/discovery/journey.json is written with JourneyRecord.ui null, JourneyRecord.declaredVia "init" and JourneyRecord.asBuilt false, and readJourneyRecord returns that record rather than null, so a new project is never read as a grandfathered tree.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-6 edge: rcf init on this version

testCases.description: [must-not] Given a tree with no journey.json, when rcf doctor runs with or without --fix, then the missing declaration appears under notices as advice and never under drift, the exit code is unchanged by it, and --fix never writes the record.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js::AC-18901-7 must-not: a tree with no journeyjson
